correctness.rationale: With outgroup survival indicator Z and crown survivor count S~Bin(9,1−q), rooted PD is Z+a1_{S>0}+(1−a)S. Independence gives the exact polynomial V_a with three terms. Its derivative at q=1/2,3/5,3/4,9/10 has signs +,−,+,− uniformly for all a∈[7/10,4/5], because all quadratic Bernstein coefficients at those q are strictly sign-correct. Descartes sign variations in descending derivative coefficients (-,-,+,-,+) cap positive roots at three, so the three bracketed roots are simple and give two maxima. For a fully resolved ten-tip caterpillar crown with 1/1000 internal increments, the exact pairwise edge-covariance identity yields four strict rational inequalities, forcing at least two maxima; continuity in edge lengths proves robustness. Independent rational mask-covariance calculation confirmed signs and Bernstein coefficient margins; no claim of ten-tip minimality or exact binary critical count.
